issues.description: Missing key prop in list items - using array index as key causes issues with reordering and state management
issues.suggestion: Use unique todo id instead: key={todo.id} instead of key={index}

issues.description: Component logic is tightly coupled with presentation - consider separating business logic
issues.suggestion: Extract todo filtering and sorting logic into a custom hook

codeQuality.summary: Component has functional structure but lacks separation of concerns and contains potential state management issues. The missing key prop is a critical bug risk that could cause unexpected behavior.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Delete operation with async confirmation not fully tested - edge cases like network errors missing
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test delete failure scenarios and user confirmation cancellation

untestedPaths.reasoning: Empty list state rendering path only has one basic test
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test empty list with various filter states and transitions

testCoverage.summary: Basic coverage exists but lacks depth in error handling and edge case scenarios. Delete and filter functionality need more comprehensive testing.

suggestions.description: Extract todo filtering and sorting logic into separate utility function
suggestions.benefits: Improves testability, reusability, and makes component logic clearer

suggestions.description: Replace inline event handlers with named functions to improve readability and debugging
suggestions.benefits: Better stack traces and clearer intent in event handling

refactorings.summary: Component has opportunities for improved structure through extraction of business logic and better event handler naming conventions.

issues.description: API endpoint hardcoded without environment variable - exposes production endpoint in source code
issues.suggestion: Use environment variables: const API_BASE = process.env.REACT_APP_API_BASE || 'http://localhost:3001'

issues.description: No error boundary or timeout handling for API calls
issues.suggestion: Implement request timeout and structured error responses with proper error codes

issues.description: Missing request/response validation - assumes API response structure
issues.suggestion: Add schema validation using libraries like zod or yup for type safety

codeQuality.summary: Service layer lacks security hardening and error handling. The hardcoded endpoint is a security concern that must be addressed before production deployment.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Update operation lacks tests for conflict scenarios (409 responses) and partial updates
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock 409 conflict responses and test optimistic update rollback

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests for network timeout or slow connection scenarios
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test timeout behavior and implement retry mechanism tests

untestedPaths.reasoning: Error handling utility function not tested independently
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test various error codes (400, 401, 500) and response formats

testCoverage.summary: Coverage is below target. Critical gaps in error handling, network resilience, and edge case scenarios need immediate attention.

suggestions.description: Replace fetch with axios for better error handling and request/response interceptors
suggestions.benefits: Better error handling, automatic JSON parsing, interceptor support for auth tokens

suggestions.description: Reduce repeated fetch wrapper code by creating generic request helper
suggestions.benefits: DRY principle, easier maintenance, consistent error handling

refactorings.summary: Service layer would benefit from modernization with axios and extraction of common request patterns.

issues.description: Missing dependency in useEffect - filter parameter changes are not tracked
issues.suggestion: Add filter to dependency array: useEffect(() => {...}, [filter, todos])

issues.description: Callback functions not memoized - causes unnecessary renders in child components
issues.suggestion: Wrap handlers with useCallback: const handleAdd = useCallback((todo) => {...}, [])

codeQuality.summary: Custom hook implements core todo logic well but has a critical dependency issue in useEffect that could cause stale state. Memoization would improve performance.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Adding duplicate todos and validation logic not tested
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test duplicate prevention, validation errors, and boundary conditions

testCoverage.summary: Good baseline coverage with main paths tested. Additional tests needed for validation and edge cases in todo creation.

suggestions.description: Consider using useReducer instead of multiple useState for complex state transitions
suggestions.benefits: Cleaner state management, easier to reason about state transitions, better for complex interactions

refactorings.summary: Hook could benefit from useReducer pattern for handling multiple related state updates.

recommendations.description: Remove hardcoded API endpoint from source code and use environment variables for all configuration values
Fix missing key props in TodoList component - replace array index with unique todo id to prevent state inconsistencies during list reordering
Increase test coverage for error handling and edge cases in api service (target 80%+) - focus on network failures, timeouts, and conflict scenarios
Fix useEffect dependency array in useTodo hook to include all external values that change over time
Extract business logic from TodoList component into custom hooks and utility functions to improve testability and reusability
